panel.language.label: Language
panel.language.desc: UI text language: en (English) or zh (中文). Applies immediately.
panel.mode.label: Mode
panel.mode.desc.on: Pi TUI style with rich edit/write diffs. Tune diff options below.
panel.mode.desc.compact: (Experimental) One summary line per assistant round; edit/write reuse the same Diff preview settings as on.
panel.mode.desc.off: Pi native tool rendering. Diff options below still apply independently.
panel.exclude.label: Exclude tools
panel.exclude.desc.none: No tools excluded. Agent always keeps its dedicated renderer. Enter to toggle common tools.
panel.exclude.desc.some: Native renderer for: {names}. Agent is always native. Enter to toggle.
panel.exclude.agent.desc: Agent always uses its dedicated renderer and cannot be forced through pi-tui.
panel.exclude.item.desc: Use Pi native renderer for {name} instead of Pi TUI styling.
panel.number.custom.label: {label} — custom value:
panel.number.enter.hint: Enter to apply · Esc to go back
panel.toolInput.label: Input clip
panel.toolInput.desc: Max characters for path/command/name in single and grouped tool summaries. Enter to type a custom value.
panel.diffView.label: Diff layout
panel.diffView.desc.auto: Auto: split when terminal is wide enough, otherwise unified.
panel.diffView.desc.split: Force side-by-side diff when width allows; otherwise unified.
panel.diffView.desc.unified: Always render a single unified diff column.
panel.diffIndicator.label: Diff indicator
panel.diffIndicator.desc.bars: Vertical bar indicators on changed lines (default).
panel.diffIndicator.desc.none: No change indicators; rely on color alone.
panel.diffIndent.label: Indent guide
panel.diffIndent.desc.off: Keep leading indentation as plain spaces.
panel.diffIndent.desc.dots: Visualize leading indentation as dim dots (·) up to 16 columns deep; inline alignment is untouched.
panel.diffEmphasis.label: Segment emphasis
panel.diffEmphasis.desc.bg: Blended background tint for changed segments (default, works on every terminal).
panel.diffEmphasis.desc.inverse: Reverse-video (SGR 7) for changed segments — position stays visible regardless of terminal palette.
panel.diffSplit.label: Split min width
panel.diffSplit.desc: Minimum terminal width before auto/split layout uses side-by-side columns. Enter to type a custom value.
panel.editCollapsed.label: Edit collapsed lines
panel.editCollapsed.desc: How many edit/diff body lines to show before the expand hint (Ctrl+O / click). Write uses its own setting below.
panel.writeCollapsed.label: Write collapsed lines
panel.writeCollapsed.desc: Write-only collapsed body lines. 0 shows ↳ created + expand hint (stats stay on the title). Enter to type a custom value.
panel.wordWrap.label: Diff word wrap
panel.wordWrap.desc.on: Long diff lines wrap within the panel width.
panel.wordWrap.desc.off: Long diff lines are truncated to the panel width.
panel.expandedMax.label: Expanded max lines
panel.expandedMax.desc: Max Output/diff body lines when expanded. Default 40 keeps the TUI compact; raise for large dumps.
panel.thinkingTitle.label: Summary title
panel.thinkingTitle.desc: Use the latest provider summary as the active thinking title.
panel.previewLines.label: Preview lines
panel.previewLines.desc: Thinking preview lines; 0 hides the preview body.
panel.animation.label: Animation interval ms
panel.animation.desc: Thinking title animation interval for the next thinking run.
panel.dimThinking.label: Dim thinking text
panel.dimThinking.desc.on: Thinking text uses the theme's dim color.
panel.dimThinking.desc.off: Keep the default thinking text color.
panel.startupHeader.label: Startup header
panel.startupHeader.desc.on: Show the boxed animated logo header (model/cwd + command tips) on new sessions.
panel.startupHeader.desc.off: Use Pi's native startup header instead.
panel.feature.footer.label: Custom footer
panel.feature.footer.desc.on: Replace Pi's built-in footer with the status line: model · thinking | context progress; cwd | branch | MCP | CH | cost. Applies immediately.
panel.scrollStep.label: Scroll step
panel.scrollStep.desc: Mouse wheel scroll lines in fullscreen mode.
panel.streamingReveal.label: Streaming reveal
panel.streamingReveal.desc.off: Assistant text appears as it arrives (default native behavior).
panel.streamingReveal.desc.on: Assistant text streams in at ~30fps instead of jumping in whole chunks (experimental).
panel.feature.workingMessage.label: Working message
panel.feature.workingMessage.desc.on: Extend Working... footer with token count and elapsed time. Next restart applies.
panel.feature.aliases.label: Aliases
panel.feature.aliases.desc.on: /clear and /exit aliases enabled. Next restart applies.
panel.feature.agentSummary.label: Agent summary
panel.feature.agentSummary.desc.on: Append per-round tool stats after each agent turn. Next restart applies.
panel.feature.contextCommand.label: Context usage
panel.feature.contextCommand.desc.on: /context shows context-window distribution with previews. Next restart applies.
panel.footer: Enter/Space to change · Enter on numbers types a custom value · Tab/Shift+Tab to switch sections · Esc to close
command.tui.desc: Configure Pi TUI style and rich diff options
command.tui.compact: One summary line per assistant message
command.tui.language: UI text language: en or zh
command.tui.languageInvalid: Invalid language: {value}. Use en or zh.

context.title: Context Usage
context.subtitle: {used} / {total} tokens ({percent}%)
context.footer: ↑↓ select · Click / Enter to preview · [esc] close
context.empty.toolResults: No tool results in the current context.
